title: Open a New Savings Account This Month
paragraphs: Sunrise Bank is pleased to announce a special offer for new customers. Open a new savings account before the end of August and enjoy an interest rate of 3.5 percent for the first six months.

There is no fee for a deposit or withdrawal made at any branch, and every transaction can be tracked through our mobile application. Simply bring valid identification and an initial deposit of at least NT$2,000 to open your account.
Existing customers who refer a friend will receive a cash bonus once the new account reaches a balance of NT$10,000. Visit any branch or call our service line to learn more about this offer.

questions.stem: What is required to open the account?
options: Valid identification and an initial deposit of at least NT$2,000
A recommendation from an existing customer

questions.stem: What is the interest rate offered for the first six months?
What will most likely happen if a customer refers a friend and the new account reaches NT$10,000?
options: The account will be closed automatically
The referring customer will receive a cash bonus
